answer_1.quote: The aim of data-to-text (D2T) generation is to produce natural language descriptions of structured data.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions from RDF triples

answer_2.quote: Following prior work, we use BLEU and METEOR to evaluate the outputs against the human references.

answer_4.quote: Since automatic performance metrics do not provide insights into specific weaknesses of the system, we manually examined 100 outputs of the models.
answer_4.guideline: We counted the number of errors: factual (hallucinations, omissions, incorrect fact merging, redundancies) and grammatical.
